message.content: {"reasoning": "The line 'Give me, give me! O, tell not me of fear!' is spoken by King Richard II in Act 1, Scene 2 of *Richard II*. He says this to Bolingbroke (Mowbray) after Mowbray has challenged him to a single combat, expressing his eagerness for the fight and dismissing any notion of cowardice or hesitation.", "speaker": "KING RICHARD II"}
